statement: A deterministic five-node cold-formation simulator on the in-process path - virtual clock, seeded in-memory transport, a discrete-event scheduler charging each node's virtual time per owner from the committed calibration table, real owners throughout, and a guard that throws on any ambient clock or timer read in deterministic mode - reproduces the seed-starvation signature of main (seed gap fraction at least 50 percent with every joiner under 5 percent, incomplete-lease observations naming all five nodes with escalating backoff, prioritySpreadGap non-decreasing with zero operations in flight, admission ending in control_plane_pressure), two runs of one seed produce byte-identical reports, the signature holds across a 0.5x-2x one-dimensional sweep of every coefficient, a run completes in under 60 seconds of real time, and a live report plus its log archive can be ingested as a canonical scenario.

constraints.statement: The harness adapts transport and storage interfaces only; it never reproduces an owner's decision logic, and every adapter carries a contract test naming what it simplifies.
The signature must hold at every point of a 0.5x-2x sweep of each calibration coefficient with the others fixed; a simulator that reproduces only at the fitted point is rejected.
The runner refuses to start when a required work class lacks non-negative coefficients with artifact provenance; unknown keys never cost zero silently.
Deterministic mode throws nondeterministic_owner_seam on an ambient clock read or timer scheduling inside a tagged owner dispatch, and the reproduction check proves the guard by mutation.
Live and simulated producers emit the same additive formationMetrics object in the existing report schema; formationVerdict and the budget readers consume either without a simulator branch.
Every owner time seam lands as one bounded, independently verified commit with a head-red or red-on-revert test.
